description: This PHP source file defines the 'Extract' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for extracting substrings such as left, mid, right, and text before/after specified delimiters, tailored for use in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Extract
classes.description: A class providing static methods for extracting substrings and parts of text, supporting array inputs, intended for spreadsheet calculation functions.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the start of a string or array of strings.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Extracts a substring from the middle of a string or array of strings, starting at a specified position.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the end of a string or array of strings.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Extracts text before a specified delimiter, supporting multiple optional parameters, including case sensitivity and instance count.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Extracts text after a specified delimiter, similar to 'before', with additional parameters for instance and match options.
